login.title: Welcome back
login.description: Sign in to continue tracking your nutrition.
login.passwordChanged: Password changed. Sign in with your new password.

register.title: Create account
register.description: Create an account and verify your email. Registering again before verification keeps your original name and password.
register.success: Account created. Please check your email to verify it.

verify.title: Verify your email
verify.description: Enter the OTP from your email to verify your account. Request another code if needed.
verify.success: Email verified. You can now sign in.
verify.resent: If verification is required and limits allow it, a new code will be sent. You can still use your existing code.

google.unavailable: Google Sign-In is unavailable. Please try again later.

hero.title: Every meal.
hero.description: Take a moment for today’s meals. Understand more about what nourishes you every day.

benefits.diary: Keep a record of what you eat each day.
benefits.overview: Review your nutrition day by day.

otp.label: Verification code
otp.hint: Enter the six-digit code from your email. Codes expire after 5 minutes and allow up to 5 attempts.
otp.limits: Codes expire after 5 minutes with up to 5 incorrect attempts. Wait at least 60 seconds between requests; the limit is 5 codes per hour across both password flows. A new code replaces the old one. The timer is advisory; the server determines validity and limits.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.description: Enter your account email to request a password reset code.
forgot.notice: If the account is eligible, an OTP will be sent to your email.
